title: Cancer-Related Mutations Alter RNA-Driven Functional Cross-Talk Underlying Premature-Messenger RNA Recognition by Splicing Factor SF3b.
authors: Spinello, Angelo; Janos, Pavel; Rozza, Riccardo; Magistrato, Alessandra
journal: The journal of physical chemistry letters
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟和动态网络理论揭示SF3b剪接因子突变如何通过RNA介导的变构串扰影响pre-mRNA识别，属于蛋白质-RNA互作而非TF-DNA体系，但方法可迁移至蛋白质-DNA互作建模。
abstract: The pillar of faithful premature-messenger (pre-mRNA) splicing is the precise recognition of key intronic sequences by specific splicing factors. The heptameric splicing factor 3b (SF3b) recognizes the branch point sequence (BPS), a key part of the 3' splice site. SF3b contains SF3B1, a protein holding recurrent cancer-associated mutations. Among these, K700E, the most-frequent SF3B1 mutation, triggers aberrant splicing, being primarily implicated in hematologic malignancies. Yet, K700E and the BPS recognition site are 60 A apart, suggesting the existence of an allosteric cross-talk between the two distal spots. Here, we couple molecular dynamics simulations and dynamical network theory analysis to unlock the molecular terms underpinning the impact of SF3b splicing factor mutations on pre-mRNA selection. We establish that by weakening and remodeling interactions of pre-mRNA with SF3b, K700E scrambles RNA-mediated allosteric cross-talk between the BPS and the mutation site. We propose that the altered allostery contributes to cancer-associated missplicing by mutated SF3B1. This finding broadens our comprehension of the elaborate mechanisms underlying pre-mRNA metabolism in eukaryotes.
abstract_zh: 忠实的前体信使RNA（pre-mRNA）剪接的支柱在于特定剪接因子对关键内含子序列的精确识别。七聚体剪接因子3b（SF3b）识别分支点序列（BBS），这是3'剪接位点的关键部分。SF3b包含SF3B1，一种携带反复出现的癌症相关突变的蛋白质。其中，K700E是SF3B1最常见的突变，触发异常剪接，主要涉及血液系统恶性肿瘤。然而，K700E与BPS识别位点相距60埃，暗示这两个远端位点之间存在变构交叉对话。在此，我们结合分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和动态网络理论分析，以揭示SF3b剪接因子突变对pre-mRNA选择影响的分子机制。我们确定，通过削弱和重塑pre-mRNA与SF3b的相互作用，K700E扰乱了BPS与突变位点之间RNA介导的变构交叉对话。我们提出，这种改变的变构效应有助于突变型SF3B1引起的癌症相关错误剪接。这一发现拓宽了我们对真核生物pre-mRNA代谢复杂机制的理解。
